title: Molecular connectivity indices and soil properties to predict the sorption of per- and poly-fluoroalkyl substances
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, 28,1356-1373
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00532A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Paulina Alulema-Pullupaxi, Fatih Evrendilek, Dilara Hatinoglu, Simin Moavenzadeh Ghaznavi, Kenneth Mensah, Manisha Choudhary, Sonora Ortiz, Onur Apul
This study presents a modeling approach to predict the soil-water partitioning coefficient for per- and poly-fluoroalkyl substances as a function of their molecular connectivity indices and soil properties.
